allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\Java\\latest" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\scoop\\apps","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name; Get-Command javac -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Source)

PowerShell(New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools" | Out-Null; curl.exe -sL -o "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools\\jdk21.zip" "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/21/ga/windows/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse"; if \($?\) { "JDK download done: $\(\(Get-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools\\jdk21.zip"\).Length / 1MB -as [int]\) MB" })

PowerShell(curl.exe -sL -o "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools\\maven.zip" "https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.9.11/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.11-bin.zip"; $size = \(Get-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools\\maven.zip"\).Length; if \($size -lt 1MB\) { "Download too small \($size bytes\) - trying to list available versions"; curl.exe -s "https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/" } else { "Maven download done: $\($size / 1MB -as [int]\) MB" })

PowerShell(curl.exe -sL -o "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools\\maven.zip" "https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.9.16/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.16-bin.zip"; $size = \(Get-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\\tools\\maven.zip"\).Length; if \($size -gt 1MB\) { "Maven download done: $\([math]::Round\($size / 1MB\)\) MB" } else { "FAILED: $size bytes" })
